notes.content:
Day 112 of the experiment.

The subject has gone rogue. Last seen scavenging through an old barn, mumbling something about a toaster from 1986 and “the deal of a lifetime.” 🧠🍞

We’re not sure if this is a side effect of serum X-4 or just good ol’ obsession—but one thing is certain:
Barn Finders, that wild, dirty, absolutely bonkers game about junk hunting and treasure flipping, just hit its biggest discount ever.

🧲 From April 16th to 30th, you can grab Barn Finders with a massive 75% off during Steam’s Daily Deal!
No, you’re not hallucinating. Yes, it’s very real. And possibly contagious.

🎯 Sound familiar?

In Tales of Tomorrow, you’re pushing the limits of sanity and survival.

In Barn Finders, you’re pushing the limits of how much money you can make from a used shower and a haunted fridge.
Both are strange. Both are experiments. You’re the variable.

Dive into the madness here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/991170/Barn_Finders/

Explore. Discover. Profit.
Then come back for your next round of testing… maybe with a new chair for your padded cell?

notes.title: Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment - devlog #4 [teaser]
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Q4PkAtUUKJE;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear space Explorers,

I need to warn you. I thought, just like you, that Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment is a simple game where you can enjoy the views, cheat an AI, and easily escape from the spaceship controlled by AR.I.A. That's a lie! Indeed, I've succeeded, but it cost me almost a life.

 First, I didn't even notice when I started to complete all the tasks given to me by AR.I.A. She was such convincing...
 Second, when I realized I'm stuck on the spaceship forever, I started to figure out how to escape. It's not easy when your food rations and stamina are limited, observed and examined by artificial intelligence.
 Third, I thought I'm not gonna encounter anything worse than tyrant AI. I didn't know everything about the spaceship earlier. And about the others...
Just remember, play the 'game' at your own risk. And first, read the warnings below. Good luck!
- Anonymous Astronaut

***

3 things you should know about Tales Of Tomorrow: Experiment:

1. You are on the space station controlled by AI - AR.I.A. 🤖
2. Obey every command and you will be rewarded. 🏆
Disobey and you will be punished. 🩸
3. It is a short story game with high replayability. 🔁

Will you survive❓

***
